title: Oven Roasted Argentinian Lamb Shank Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring tender lamb shanks in a rich and aromatic broth, inspired by the bold flavors of Argentina
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit
Season the lamb shanks with salt, black pepper, paprika, and dried oregano
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat
Sear the lamb shanks until browned on all sides, then remove from pot
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for an additional minute
Add the red wine to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom
Add the beef broth to the pot and bring to a boil
Return the lamb shanks to the pot, cover, and transfer to the preheated oven
Braise the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and falling off the bone
